items.q: Match each step of the pressure-natriuresis mechanism with what follows — 1) ↑ CO 2) ↓ Reabsorption from PCT 3) ↑ Medullary blood flow … A) ↑ Na+ & H2O excretion B) ↑ RBF C) ↑ RIHP
items.exp: ↑ CO → ↑ RBF → ↓ reabsorption from PCT → ↑ RIHP → ↑ medullary blood flow → ↑ Na+ & H2O excretion. (Book p739)
